secrets.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token). Required for the bot to log in and start.

secrets.name: CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Discord application client ID from the Discord Developer Portal (General Information → Application ID). Required for slash command registration.

secrets.name: GUILD_ID
secrets.description: Discord server (guild) ID for single-server slash command registration. Optional — leave empty for multi-guild mode.
